findings.message: The snapshot mutation regression mutates original u/qa while evaluate receives u.copy()/qa.copy() at line 228. It does not mutate the caller objects actually passed to evaluation and would pass without snapshot isolation. Mutate the exact passed arrays after capture and verify the complete trial remains bound to its snapshot.

Mandatory station/channel transport coverage is incomplete. Numbering/passive/director tests check aggregate energy and force/tangent only, and common-motion/rebase checks omit per-channel station values, weights, tensors, positions and derivative-column transport. The implementation document explicitly leaves full shell station transport open. Complete these frozen obligations for all four shapes and all D4/D3 operations before accepting the full local inventory.

scope.acceptance_boundary: Read-only implementation and mandatory inventory review. No reviewer mechanics execution or accepted local result; author smoke/full passes do not waive missing coverage. Conventional finite Q4 PHYSICAL_RECOVERY, graph/state/restart and G3c/full parity remain open.
